newsitem.title: UK: All three Brent dates kept, one sold on - trade.
newsitem.headline: All three Brent dates kept, one sold on - trade.

text.p: All three Brent cargoes due to turn wet on Friday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The August 10-12 loader was kept by BP and promptly sold on to a Wall Street trader at August paper evens, the trade sources said.
The August 9-11 combination cargo was kept by U.S. trader J.Aron and the August 11-13 loader was kept by Shell, they added.
